integrity: The proof separates parameter ramification on the full camera compactification from the singular rank-one image stratum and uses the published identification of the smooth stratum with PGL_2. Finite exact computations are reported only as consistency checks, not as the uniform proof.
scientific_limitations: Generic distinct world points and generic Euclidean data in the conventional affine output chart; characteristic-zero complex ED count only; no claim for nongeneric configurations or higher-dimensional resectioning.
title: Proof of the \(3n-8\) ED-degree formula for one-dimensional camera resectioning
